service_id.title: Service Id
service_id.description: Platform-authored run: the service whose pinned config the agent runs.

version_set.description: Named version set on the service whose pinned config the run uses (platform runs).

framework.title: Framework
framework.description: Framework a PLATFORM run executes on. For a native run the framework comes from the definition.

native.description: Run a native (bring-your-own) agent definition instead of a platform service.

message.title: Message
message.description: User message the framework agent is invoked with.

timeout_s.title: Timeout S
timeout_s.description: Server-side wall-clock budget for the run, in seconds (max 300).

definition_id.title: Definition Id
definition_id.description: Registered definition to run. Omit `version` for the latest.

version.title: Version
version.description: Pinned definition version; omit for latest.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: Inline definition document (dev/playground). Validated by the platform clamp schema.

NativeRunRef.title: NativeRunRef
NativeRunRef.description:
Run a customer-authored NATIVE agent definition (inc-10): a REGISTERED
definition by id (``version`` omitted = latest), or an INLINE body for
dev/playground iteration. The definition's own ``framework`` selects the
runtime — no top-level ``framework`` needed.
